t: The Fortress Trade 1.5" Flat Paint Brush offers reliable, efficient paint application for professional decorators and painters. Featuring solid, round tapered synthetic bristles and fine filament tips, it ensures superb load capacity and excellent control for precise work. Mixed filaments are engineered to significantly reduce tramlines, leaving a smooth, professional finish on interior walls and trim. Suitable for all paint types, this brush is ideal for emulsion, gloss, and other painting tasks. It includes a rust-resistant stainless steel ferrule for durability and a comfortable beavertail handle for extended use. Quick and easy to clean, it maximises efficiency on any project.
